ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 55:45 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black central pigmentation extending from the peduncle into the inner lobes. Lateral regions of both lobes are predominantly white with high-contrast black mottling. A distinctive dark circular ring is located on the white field of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped central depression with an internal angle of approximately 85 degrees and significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) with amplitudes ranging from 2-10 pixels along the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex downward curve at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, three-dimensional clusters of white, circular high-contrast pixel groups located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, indicative of barnacle colonies.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical and diagonal dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the white pigmentation of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation at the lateral tips of both lobes; minor linear scarring on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique, dark, circular 'eye-like' pigmentation spot on the upper-middle portion of the left lobe.
